Name: Object Color Stack Size Fix
Author: mytigio
Description:
[center][size=5]Object Color Stack Size Fix[/size]


[size=3]This Mod doe[/size]s nothing on it's own, as it requires a machine that uses the ObjectColor or CopyColor feature to be useful.

In Stardew Valley there is a bug where the stack size of machine outputs using the new object color features will always be reset to 1 (instead of whatever the machine is set to).

This is a small harmony patch to fix that issue until an official fix comes out.
[/center]

Manifest.Name: Colored Object Stack Size Fix
Manifest.Description: Fixes a bug in version 1.6.9 with the new Colored Object machine rules.  This issue should be resolved in 1.6.16 by the game.
Manifest.Author: mytigio
